html: Another thing, I know that having species that have a general body shape similar to ours is easier, but would/is there be a scientific explanation for the known sapient species so far following a general pattern of being mainly bipeds (and following a similar tech/historical pattern)? Is it because bipedal species (with many having hands, claws, etc.) are more likely to excell?
